sentences.en: I have done this with a loving heart for my father, Amun.
sentences.zh: 我为我的父亲阿蒙怀着慈爱之心做成了这件事。

sentences.en: I call to attention the people who shall live in the future, who should consider this monument that I made for my father.
sentences.zh: 我呼吁未来的人们注意，他们应当审视这座我为父亲建造的纪念碑。

sentences.en: It was when I was sitting in the palace that I remembered my maker.
sentences.zh: 当时我正坐在宫殿里，突然想起了我的造物主。

sentences.en: My heart directed me to make for him two obelisks of electrum, their pinnacles touching the heavens.
sentences.zh: 我的心指引我为他建造了两座电金方尖碑，它们的尖顶直触云霄。

sentences.en: Now my mind turned this way and that, anticipating the words of the people who shall see my monument in future years and will speak of what I have done.
sentences.zh: 此刻我的心思绪起伏，预想着未来几年看到我的纪念碑并会谈论我所做之事的那些人的言论。

sentences.en: He shall not declare what I have said to be an exaggeration.
sentences.zh: 他绝不会宣称我所说的话是夸大其词。

sentences.en: Rather, he will say how like her it is, loyal to her father, for I am his daughter in very truth, who glorifies him and who knows what he has ordained.
sentences.zh: 相反，他会说这多么像她啊，对父亲忠心耿耿，因为我确实是他的女儿，荣耀着他并深知他所命定的旨意。

sentences.en: So that's an inscription on the temple of Amun-Ra at Ipset-Sut in Thebes.
sentences.zh: 所以这是底比斯伊普塞特-苏特的阿蒙-拉神庙上的一处铭文。

sentences.en: The inscription, as you know, Tom, made by arguably Egypt's greatest female pharaoh, Hatshep-Sut.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，汤姆，这处铭文可以说是埃及最伟大的女法老哈特谢普苏特制作的。

sentences.en: Well, arguably, I think definitely.
sentences.zh: 嗯，可以说是，我认为绝对是。

sentences.en: Well, that's a big claim.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这可真是个宏大的说法。

sentences.en: Well, so we've done Cleopatra, haven't we?
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我们已经讲过克利奥帕特拉了，对吧？

sentences.en: We have.
sentences.zh: 我们讲过了。

sentences.en: But Cleopatra ends up a failure.
sentences.zh: 但克利奥帕特拉最终以失败告终。

sentences.en: I mean, she dies, commits suicide, her kingdom is conquered.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她死了，自杀了，她的王国被征服了。

sentences.en: Hatshep-Sut is a queen who reigns a millennium and a half before the time of Cleopatra, the beginning of the golden age of the new kingdom.
sentences.zh: 哈特谢普苏特是一位在克利奥帕特拉时代之前一个半世纪就统治的女王，那是新王国黄金时代的开端。

sentences.en: And, you know, she's not just the greatest female pharaoh.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，她不仅是最伟大的女法老。

sentences.en: She is one of the greatest pharaohs, full stop.
sentences.zh: 她就是最伟大的法老之一，毫无疑问。

sentences.en: And she's an astonishing figure.
sentences.zh: 而且她是一个令人惊叹的人物。

sentences.en: The problem with coming to terms with her and why probably she's not as well known as Cleopatra is that with Cleopatra, you have all kinds of brilliant details
sentences.zh: 要理解她所面临的问题，以及为什么她可能不如克利奥帕特拉那么知名，原因在于对于克利奥帕特拉，你有各种各样精彩的细节

sentences.en: about, you know, what she was doing, what she looked like, what she was getting up to, all that kind of stuff, who she was sleeping with.
sentences.zh: 关于，你知道的，她在做什么，她长什么样，她在忙些什么，所有诸如此类的事情，她和谁睡过觉。

sentences.en: With Hatshep-Sut, we don't have that kind of detail.
sentences.zh: 而对于哈特谢普苏特，我们没有那种细节。

sentences.en: We don't have the equivalent of a Plutarch or, you know, a biographer or historians like that giving us the details.
sentences.zh: 我们没有类似普鲁塔克，或者你知道的，传记作家或诸如此类的历史学家给我们提供细节的著作。

sentences.en: Well, the thing with Cleopatra is all the stuff about her is written by her enemies.
sentences.zh: 嗯，关于克利奥帕特拉，所有关于她的事情都是由她的敌人写的。

sentences.en: So it's all very lurid and therefore very sexy, very colourful.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都非常耸人听闻，因此非常香艳、非常多姿多彩。

sentences.en: With Hatshep-Sut, there is pretty much nothing.
sentences.zh: 而对于哈特谢普苏特，几乎什么都没有。

sentences.en: There's inscriptions, Tom.
sentences.zh: 有铭文，汤姆。

sentences.en: But, I mean, that's all we're talking about, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 但是，我的意思是，这正是我们所谈论的全部，不是吗？

sentences.en: Well, by the standards of pharaonic history, there's actually quite a lot.
sentences.zh: 嗯，以法老历史的标准来看，其实已经相当多了。

sentences.en: But by the standards of Greek or Roman history, there isn't.
sentences.zh: 但以希腊或罗马历史的标准来看，就没有了。

sentences.en: And by the standards of 20th century history, there really is almost nothing.
sentences.zh: 而以20世纪历史的标准来看，真的几乎什么都没有。

sentences.en: We know far more, Tom, about the most obscure of James Callaghan's cabinet ministers in the late 1970s than we do about this titanic woman.
sentences.zh: 关于20世纪70年代末詹姆斯·卡拉汉内阁中最默默无闻的部长，我们所知道的，汤姆，远比我们对这位伟大的女性了解的要多。

sentences.en: But I think that what you can do is to put her into the context of what is actually a very dramatic and thrilling story, which is the recovery of Egypt from a period of incredible
sentences.zh: 但我想你可以做的是，将她置于一个实际上非常戏剧性和扣人心弦的故事背景中，那就是埃及从一段难以置信的

sentences.en: humiliation and prostration.
sentences.zh: 屈辱和瘫痪中恢复过来。

sentences.en: So Hatshep-Sut is born around 1500 BC.
sentences.zh: 所以哈特谢普苏特出生于公元前1500年左右。

sentences.en: So if you go back further to kind of 3000 BC,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你再往前追溯到公元前3000年左右，

sentences.en: Egypt emerges as a unitary state along the banks of the Nile.
sentences.zh: 埃及在尼罗河两岸作为一个统一国家崛起。

sentences.en: From the beginning, you have these dynasties of kings, the idea that the monarchy lies at the heart of this kingdom, that the monarch is the kind of interface
sentences.zh: 从一开始，你就拥有这些国王王朝，这种君主制处于该王国核心的观念，即君主是一种

sentences.en: between the dimension of the gods and the dimension of the earthly realm.
sentences.zh: 神明维度与尘世维度之间的接口。

sentences.en: This first manifests itself through what is called the Old Kingdom.
sentences.zh: 这最初通过被称为古王国的时期表现出来。

sentences.en: The Old Kingdom, these are building the pyramids, all that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 古王国，这些就是建造金字塔、所有诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: Then it kind of collapses into a state of anarchy, lots of different kings.
sentences.zh: 然后它陷入无政府状态，有许多不同的国王。

sentences.en: This is seen by the Egyptians as a terrible thing.
sentences.zh: 这被埃及人视为一件可怕的事情。

sentences.en: Then they recover and establish what is called the Middle Kingdom.
sentences.zh: 然后他们恢复过来，建立了被称为中王国的时期。

sentences.en: The Middle Kingdom again then collapses around 1630 BC.
sentences.zh: 中王国随后又在公元前1630年左右崩溃。

sentences.en: And the humiliation is that the northern reaches of Egypt, which include the pyramids, which include the ancient capital of Memphis, get conquered by foreigners.
sentences.zh: 而耻辱的是，包括金字塔在内、包括古代首都孟菲斯在内的埃及北部地区被外国人征服了。

sentences.en: And these are foreigners who come from Palestine,
sentences.zh: 这些是来自巴勒斯坦的外国人，

sentences.en: Canaan, whatever you want to call it.
sentences.zh: 迦南，随你怎么称呼。

sentences.en: And this is an unconscionable humiliation, because the Egyptians are fabulously xenophobic, fabulously conscious of themselves as being superior
sentences.zh: 这是一个令人发指的耻辱，因为埃及人极其仇外，极其意识到自己相对于

sentences.en: to all the kind of the people who surround them.
sentences.zh: 周围所有这些人的优越性。

sentences.en: And so this is a cause of immense shame.
sentences.zh: 所以这是巨大的耻辱之源。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, in the south, people called the Kushites, who are kind of Nubian kingdom, who again, the Egyptians have periodically been going off and kicking sand in their faces
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在南方，被称为库什人的人们，这是一个类似于努比亚王国的政权，埃及人曾定期去那里挑衅

sentences.en: and forcing unfair trade deals on them and establishing forts along the stretches of the Nile that runs through Kush.
sentences.zh: 并向他们强加不平等的贸易协定，还在穿过库什的尼罗河流域沿岸建立堡垒。

sentences.en: They also get a bit uppity and they start kind of kicking the Egyptians around.
sentences.zh: 他们也变得有点傲慢，开始把埃及人打得落花流水。

sentences.en: So I think the parallel would be, imagine Byzantium, the Roman Empire in the 7th century.
sentences.zh: 所以我想可以做一个类比，想象一下拜占庭，公元7世纪的罗马帝国。

sentences.en: You've lost Rome, you've lost the Western half to barbarians.
sentences.zh: 你失去了罗马，你把西部一半领土丢给了蛮族。

sentences.en: And then you have the Arabs who previously had been subject to the Romans and they've nicked vast swathes of Roman provinces.
sentences.zh: 然后你有了阿拉伯人，他们以前曾臣服于罗马人，却夺走了大片罗马行省。

sentences.en: And all you've got is Byzantium.
sentences.zh: 而你所拥有的只有拜占庭。

sentences.en: And we know that the Byzantines ultimately don't recover, that the remnants of the Roman Empire in due course will be completely snuffed out.
sentences.zh: 我们知道拜占庭最终没有复苏，罗马帝国的残余终将彻底灰飞烟灭。

sentences.en: That's kind of the situation that Egypt is facing in the Hyksos period, because you have the Hyksos to the north, these Asiatic peoples, you have the Kushites to the south,
sentences.zh: 这正是埃及在喜克索斯时期所面临的处境，因为北部有喜克索斯人，这些亚洲民族，南部有库什人，

sentences.en: and you have the remnants of the Egyptian state in what comes to be called Thebes, what's now Luxor.
sentences.zh: 而埃及国家的残余则在后来被称为底比斯的地方，也就是现在的卢克索。

sentences.en: And there's no guarantee that they're necessarily going to recover, but they do, thanks to the emergence of a succession of remarkable kings and of remarkable queens.
sentences.zh: 并没有保证他们一定会复苏，但他们确实复苏了，这归功于一连串杰出的国王和杰出女王的涌现。

sentences.en: And that's what's so fascinating about it.
sentences.zh: 这就是最令人着迷的地方。

sentences.en: So sometimes, Tom, we get some comments from our listeners.
sentences.zh: 所以有时，汤姆，我们会收到听众的一些评论。

sentences.en: So actually some from quite sort of longstanding listeners, and they say, we wish you could do more powerful women, women with agency,
sentences.zh: 实际上有一些来自相当资深的听众，他们说，我们希望你们能多讲讲强大的女性，有自主性的女性，

sentences.en: women who aren't just being kicked around by men or seen through men's eyes and so on.
sentences.zh: 那些不仅仅是被男人们欺负或通过男人的眼光来看待的女性等等。

sentences.en: And you could argue, couldn't you, that Hatshepsut, who we'll come to after we've done the context, that she's one of the most outstanding early examples, isn't she,
sentences.zh: 你也可以说，不是吗，哈特谢普苏特——我们在讲完背景后就会讲到她——她是女性拥有真正帝国自主性的最杰出的早期例证之一，对吧，

sentences.en: of a woman with real imperial agency.
sentences.zh: 一个具有真正帝国自主性的女性。

sentences.en: Well, her name literally means the foremost of noble women.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她的名字字面意思是贵妇之首。

sentences.en: And I guess that that's a very accurate description.
sentences.zh: 我想这是一个非常准确的描述。

sentences.en: I mean, she is incredibly formidable and able leader.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她是一位极其令人敬畏且能力卓越的领袖。

sentences.en: I mean, it is obviously very, very unusual for women to rule.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，女性统治显然是非常非常罕见的。

sentences.en: The Egyptians don't have a word for queen.
sentences.zh: 埃及人没有“女王”这个词。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: All women are defined in terms of their relationship to the king.
sentences.zh: 所有女性都是根据她们与国王的关系来定义的。

sentences.en: So the mother of the king, the wife of the king, whatever.
sentences.zh: 所以国王的母亲，国王的妻子，诸如此类。

sentences.en: There had been one woman who had ruled as king at the end of the Middle Kingdom.
sentences.zh: 在中王国末期曾有一位女性作为国王统治过。

sentences.en: But otherwise, the idea that a woman could rule as king was obviously, you know, it generated all kinds of tensions.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，女性可以作为国王统治这种想法显然，你知道的，引发了各种各样的紧张关系。

sentences.en: So Hatshepsut, in that sense, is a real innovator.
sentences.zh: 所以在这种意义上，哈特谢普苏特是一个真正的创新者。

sentences.en: But she's not coming from nowhere.
sentences.zh: 但她并不是凭空出现的。

sentences.en: And her forebears, so the succession of extraordinary warrior pharaohs, who first of all, they conquer the territory that's lost and they then expand northwards into the Near East
sentences.zh: 她的前辈，也就是一连串非凡的武士法老，他们首先征服了失去的领土，然后向北扩展到近东，

sentences.en: and southwards back into Cush.
sentences.zh: 向南扩展回库什。

sentences.en: So they are very formidable, militarist in the classic sense of a male pharaoh.
sentences.zh: 所以他们非常强大，是传统意义上的男性法老那样的军国主义者。

sentences.en: But they are surrounded by incredibly formidable women who often serve as regents.
sentences.zh: 但他们被极其强大的女性所环绕，这些女性通常担任摄政王。

sentences.en: Those are the two traditions that Hatshepsut is drawing on.
sentences.zh: 这就是哈特谢普苏特所借鉴的两大传统。

sentences.en: The idea that Egypt is a great power but also this idea that women do absolutely have agency in this period.
sentences.zh: 埃及是一个大国的理念，以及女性在这个时期绝对拥有自主权的理念。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So I know you want to talk a little bit about the context, don't you?
sentences.zh: 所以我知道你想多聊聊背景，对吧？

sentences.en: About the sort of the geographical, political, diplomatic context for all this.
sentences.zh: 关于这一切的地理、政治、外交背景。

sentences.en: Because you were saying that we are what?
sentences.zh: 因为你刚才说我们是什么？

sentences.en: We are at about 6500 years before the birth of ChriSt.
sentences.zh: 我们大约在基督诞生前6500年。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So Greece and Rome are nothing.
sentences.zh: 所以希腊和罗马算不上什么。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And Egypt has been through this terrible sort of, you know, it's been relegated basically.
sentences.zh: 而埃及经历过这种糟糕的，你知道的，它基本上被降级了。

sentences.en: Well, it's struggling to, yes, it's been relegated to the early leagues and it's struggling to avoid going into receivership.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它在努力，是的，它被降级到了低级联赛，正在努力避免进入接管状态。

sentences.en: It's West Bromwich Albion.
sentences.zh: 就像西布朗维奇阿尔比恩足球俱乐部一样。

sentences.en: You know, it's a constant threat.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这是持续的威胁。

sentences.en: And then it comes back.
sentences.zh: 然后它卷土重来。

sentences.en: Egypt comes back.
sentences.zh: 埃及卷土重来。

sentences.en: So the Hyksos, who are these Asiatic kings who have established themselves in the north of Egypt, obviously they start to adopt
sentences.zh: 所以喜克索斯人，这些在埃及北部建立政权的亚洲国王，显然开始采用

sentences.en: Egyptian customs and practices, but they always remain self-consciously foreign.
sentences.zh: 埃及的风俗习惯，但他们始终自觉地保持着外国人的身份。

sentences.en: They have temples to their own gods.
sentences.zh: 他们为自己的神明建造神庙。

sentences.en: They practice their own fashions.
sentences.zh: 他们遵循自己的时尚。

sentences.en: The reason that they've been so successful is that they have a new military weapon, namely the chariot.
sentences.zh: 他们之所以如此成功，是因为他们拥有了一种新的军事武器，即战车。

sentences.en: And it takes time for the Egyptians to adopt that.
sentences.zh: 埃及人花了一段时间才采用这种武器。

sentences.en: But in due course of, you know, the famous image of Tutankhamen in his chariot or Ramesses the Great, whatever, the chariot will become a kind of defining emblem of the pharaoh.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，你知道图坦卡蒙乘战车或拉美西斯大帝等著名形象，战车将成为法老的一种标志性象征。

sentences.en: And so it takes time for the Egyptians down in Thebes to kind of develop that.
sentences.zh: 所以底比斯的埃及人需要时间来发展这一点。

sentences.en: But they do, they start to adopt
sentences.zh: 但他们做到了，他们开始采用

sentences.en: Hyksos weapons, which are much more kind of formidable than the traditional
sentences.zh: 喜克索斯人的武器，这些武器比传统的

sentences.en: Egyptian weaponry.
sentences.zh: 埃及武器要强大得多。

sentences.en: And by, well, by the kind of the 1540s, they're starting to launch attacks northwards.
sentences.zh: 到，嗯，大约到公元前1540年代，他们开始向北发动进攻。

sentences.en: So there's one king who seems to be quite successful.
sentences.zh: 所以有一位国王似乎相当成功。

sentences.en: Then he gets, he gets very brutally killed in battle.
sentences.zh: 然后他，他在战斗中被极其残酷地杀害了。

sentences.en: The autopsy on him is horrible.
sentences.zh: 对他的尸检结果极其可怕。

sentences.en: The arms and hands were left in the agonized attitude into which they had been thrown in the death spasms following the murderous attack, the evidence of which
sentences.zh: 他的手臂和双手保持着痛苦的姿态，这是在遭受谋杀性袭击后死亡痉挛中形成的，

sentences.en: is so clearly impressed on the battered face and skull.
sentences.zh: 其证据如此清晰地印在他被打得面目全非的脸庞和头骨上。

sentences.en: So Tom, where's that from?
sentences.zh: 所以汤姆，那是从哪里来的？

sentences.en: Like who wrote that down?
sentences.zh: 就像是谁写下来的？

sentences.en: So that's the autopsy who does it, who is looking at this king's mummy.
sentences.zh: 所以那是进行尸检的人，是正在检视这位国王木乃伊的人写的。

sentences.en: Oh, right.
sentences.zh: 哦，原来如此。

sentences.en: So the body has been brought back from the battle and he's, you know, it's also hurried that they can't kind of even out the limbs.
sentences.zh: 所以尸体被从战场带了回来，而且，你知道的，由于太过仓促，他们甚至无法舒展四肢。

sentences.en: They just mummify him and chuck him in his grave because they're in, you know, the exigencies of war being what they are.
sentences.zh: 他们只能把他做成木乃伊然后扔进坟墓，因为当时，你知道的，战争情况就是如此紧急。

sentences.en: But that king's son, a guy called Kamos,
sentences.zh: 但那位国王的儿子，一个叫卡莫斯的家伙，

sentences.en: he's much more successful.
sentences.zh: 他要成功得多。

sentences.en: So he boasts that his army goes like a great blast of fire that he approaches the Hyksos king in his palace and makes wine from the Hyksos king's vines and drinks it
sentences.zh: 所以他吹嘘说他的军队就像一阵烈火，他逼近了宫殿里的喜克索斯国王，用喜克索斯国王的葡萄酿酒，并在他的宫殿前

sentences.en: before his palace.
sentences.zh: 饮用。

sentences.en: And basically, you're having the sense there that things are starting to tick up for the Egyptians.
sentences.zh: 基本上，你会有一种感觉，埃及人的局势开始好转了。

sentences.en: And Kamos is succeeded by a bloke called Amos who might be either his son or his brother.
